notes: The requested award is a Certificate of Achievement, but the catalog text prints only the North Coast Paramedic A.S. Degree (39-45 credits), whose requirements include BIOL1 and a PSYCH/SOC choice that are not on the closed list. No blocks were recorded because the certificate's own requirements are not in the text; a reviewer should locate the certificate page.

For reference, the A.S. section lists: prerequisite National EMT Certification or HO-159 (0-6); required HO170A 11, HO170B 13, HO170C 1-8, HO170D 1-8 (a total of 9 units between HO-170C and HO-170D), BIOL1 4; and at least one of PSYCH1, PSYCH33, SOC1, SOC2 (3 each). Program requirements total 39; degree major total 39-45.
The Program Learning Outcomes on the page belong to the A.S. Degree and were not recorded for the certificate; it is not stated that the certificate shares them.

Careers were taken from the page's Career Information heading, which appears to apply to the program as a whole. The A.S. description also names 'Paramedics', but that was not recorded because it is in the degree's own description.
